# frozen_string_literal: true

# Z3 follow-up: Arel-style forwarding to a method with an explicit &block.
require "json"
require "digest"
mode = ARGV.fetch(0)
abort "wrong ZJIT" unless RubyVM::ZJIT.enabled? == (mode == "zjit")
abort "wrong YJIT" unless RubyVM::YJIT.enabled? == (mode == "yjit")

def collect_bind(value, &block)
  yield(value)
end

def forward_bind(value, &block)
  collect_bind(value, &block) - collect_bind(3, &block)
end

BIND_BLOCK = ->(n) { n * 7 }

def hot_loop(n)
  i = total = 0
  while i < n
    total += forward_bind(11, &BIND_BLOCK)
    i += 1
  end
  total
end

100.times { abort "wrong warmup" unless hot_loop(2_000) == 112_000 }
GC.start
n = ARGV[1] ? Integer(ARGV.fetch(1)) : 2_000_000
if ENV["LOWRAIL_CALLGRIND_EXT"]
  require ENV.fetch("LOWRAIL_CALLGRIND_EXT")
  GC.disable
end
before = RubyVM::ZJIT.stats if mode == "zjit" && ENV["Z3_STATS"]
objects = GC.stat(:total_allocated_objects)
started = Process.clock_gettime(Process::CLOCK_MONOTONIC)
LowrailCallgrindBench.start(false) if defined?(LowrailCallgrindBench)
result = hot_loop(n)
LowrailCallgrindBench.finish if defined?(LowrailCallgrindBench)
elapsed = Process.clock_gettime(Process::CLOCK_MONOTONIC) - started
objects = GC.stat(:total_allocated_objects) - objects
after = RubyVM::ZJIT.stats if before
abort "wrong result" unless result == 56 * n
puts JSON.generate(wall_seconds: elapsed, objects: objects, result: result,
  jit: mode, binary_sha256: Digest::SHA256.file("/proc/self/exe").hexdigest,
  ruby: RUBY_DESCRIPTION,
  jit_delta: before && after.select { |_, v| v.is_a?(Numeric) }.to_h { |k, v| [k, v - before.fetch(k, 0)] })

# frozen_string_literal: true
require "json"

def check(got, expected)
  raise "#{got.inspect} != #{expected.inspect}" unless got == expected
  got
end

def capture(n, expected, opt = 10, *rest, kw: 20, &block)
  [block.equal?(expected), yield(n + opt + rest.sum + kw), block.lambda?]
end
def call_capture(block, n = 5) = capture(n, block, 7, 2, kw: 11, &block)

def transition(expected, &block)
  [block.equal?(expected), block_given?, block && yield("雪")]
end
def call_transition(block) = transition(block, &block)

def escaped(expected, &block)
  [binding.local_variable_get(:block).equal?(expected), block.call("é")]
end
def call_escaped(block) = escaped(block, &block)

def replace_block(&block)
  before = block
  block = -> { :replacement }
  [before.call, block.call, yield]
end
def call_replace(block) = replace_block(&block)

def retain(expected, &block) = -> { [block.equal?(expected), block.call] }
def call_retain(block) = retain(block, &block)

def stack_args(a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, expected, &block)
  [block.equal?(expected), yield(a - b + c - d + e - f + g - h)]
end
def call_stack(block) = stack_args(1, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13, 17, 19, block, &block)

def strict(&block) = yield(1, 2)
def call_strict(block) = strict(&block)
def returning(&block) = yield
def call_returning
  block = proc { return :returned }
  returning(&block)
  :wrong
end
def call_breaking
  block = proc { break :bad }
  returning(&block)
rescue LocalJumpError
  :local_jump_error
end

class Coercible
  attr_reader :calls
  def initialize(block) = (@block, @calls = block, 0)
  def to_proc
    @calls += 1
    @block
  end
end
def coerce(expected, &block) = [block.equal?(expected), block.call("µ")]
def call_coerce(obj, expected) = coerce(expected, &obj)

class ChildProc < Proc; end
def renamed(expected, &block) = [block.equal?(expected), block.call]
alias old_renamed renamed
def call_alias(block) = old_renamed(block, &block)

unicode = ->(n) { "λ#{n}" }
plain = proc { |n| "λ#{n}" }
text = ->(s) { s + "🦊" }
zero = -> { :original }
300.times do
  check(call_capture(unicode), [true, "λ25", true])
  check(call_escaped(text), [true, "é🦊"])
  check(call_replace(zero), [:original, :replacement, :original])
  check(call_retain(zero).call, [true, :original])
  check(call_stack(unicode), [true, "λ-8"])
  check(call_transition(text), [true, true, "雪🦊"])
  check(call_returning, :returned)
  check(call_breaking, :local_jump_error)
  check(call_alias(zero), [true, :original])
end

results = {}
results[:proc] = check(call_capture(plain), [true, "λ25", false])
results[:side_exit] = check(call_capture(unicode, 5.5), [true, "λ25.5", true])
results[:nil] = check(call_transition(nil), [true, false, nil])
results[:symbol] = check(call_transition(:upcase), [false, true, "雪"])
child = ChildProc.new { |s| s + "ß" }
results[:subclass] = check(call_transition(child), [true, true, "雪ß"])
obj = Coercible.new(text)
results[:coercion] = check(call_coerce(obj, text), [true, "µ🦊"])
results[:coercion_once] = check(obj.calls, 1)
results[:strict] = begin
  300.times { call_strict(->(x) { x }) }
rescue ArgumentError
  :argument_error
end
check(results[:strict], :argument_error)
results[:loose] = check(call_strict(proc { |x| x }), 1)
GC.verify_compaction_references(double_heap: true, toward: :empty)
results[:gc] = check(call_capture(unicode), [true, "λ25", true])
results[:escaped] = check(call_escaped(text), [true, "é🦊"])
results[:replace] = check(call_replace(zero), [:original, :replacement, :original])
results[:retained] = check(call_retain(zero).call, [true, :original])
results[:stack] = check(call_stack(unicode), [true, "λ-8"])
results[:return] = check(call_returning, :returned)
results[:break] = check(call_breaking, :local_jump_error)
def renamed(expected, &block) = :new
results[:alias] = check(call_alias(zero), [true, :original])
puts JSON.generate(results)
